collections.title: micro AGU
collections.heading: micro AGU: from a small parafoil to autonomous flight.
intro: Start with the build: the canopy, printed payload, avionics, and propulsion. Then follow the flight tests at Barrett Park in Hood River, tuning in a simple simulator, and autonomous missions at Collin’s house in Trout Lake.

The controller story has two phases, each covering steering and altitude: the original design through Trout Lake, then the subsequent simulation, classical analysis and refined controller. Animations accompany both; appendices preserve the experimental record.

collections.title: SV Blue Dog
collections.heading: Blue Dog: designing a small autonomous sailboat.
intro: Blue Dog is my attempt to build a small boat that can sail a Columbia River Gorge round trip on its own. The design connects hull, rig, sensing, energy and recovery around one working candidate: IC-01.
Start with the story, then follow the engineering questions from mission to measurements. The series assumes basic systems engineering knowledge, but no familiarity with this project or SysML.
